In that formula: 

- _E_<sup>¯</sup> 0 **(or** _⟨E⟩_ 0 **):** The **mean (average) energy per electron** at absolute zero temperature ( _T_ = 0 K). 

- _U_ 0 **:** The **total internal kinetic energy of the entire electron gas** (all _N_ free electrons combined) at absolute zero temperature ( _T_ = 0 K). 

## **The Physical Connection** 

1. **At** _T_ = 0 **K:** Due to the **Pauli Exclusion Principle** , all electrons cannot collapse into the lowest ground state. Instead, they stack up into higher and higher energy levels from 0 up to the maximum level, the **Fermi Energy (** _EF_ **)** . 

2. **Average Energy (** _E_<sup>¯</sup> 0 **):** Because energy levels are filled from 0 to _EF_ , the average energy of a single electron in 3D is **60% of the maximum Fermi energy** : 



<!-- Start of picture text -->
E ¯0 = 3<br>5 EF<br><!-- End of picture text -->

3. **Total Energy (** _U_ 0 **):** To find the total energy of all _N_ electrons in the solid, you simply multiply the total number of electrons by the average energy per electron: 



<!-- Start of picture text -->
U 0 =  N × E ¯ 0 =  N ( 53 EF ) = 3 5 NEF<br><!-- End of picture text -->

## **Important Note for GATE** 

- In classical physics, at _T_ = 0 K, thermal motion stops completely, so classical total kinetic energy would be 0. 

- In quantum mechanics, _U_ 0 =<sup><u>3</u></sup> 5<sup>_NEF̸_=0.Thisnon-zeroenergyatabsolutezero</sup> is a pure quantum effect called **zero-point Fermi energy** , which creates a huge **Fermi pressure** holding up metals and white dwarf stars against collapse!
